sources.title: Sivir Build Guide: The Ricochet Reign | An in-depth Sivir Guide!

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.text: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.text: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.text: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.text: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.text: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

archetype.value: Sivir is an ADC who uses wave clear and team utility to control the map.

axis.value: Sivir plays by shoving waves and choosing when to rotate.

winCondition.value: Sivir wins through wave clear, well-timed rotations, and effective use of On The Hunt.

spikes.at: Essence Reaver, Berserker's Greaves, and Navori Flickerblade
spikes.why: Sivir reaches a standard power spike with these items.
Sivir can throw Boomerang Blade more often.

mistakes.value: Sivir struggles when she mismanages mana or positions without accounting for her short range.
